Dear Mark Ellis,

Thank you for your recent communication regarding the duplicate charges on your September direct debit for account 77120394. We understand your disappointment and appreciate your long-standing relationship with Northgate Bank.

Upon review, we have determined that the duplicate charges were indeed made in error. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and are pleased to inform you that we will refund the duplicate £84.50 within 5 working days from the date of this letter.

We also want to assure you that Northgate Bank upholds the complaint and does not consent to waive the ombudsman's time limits. We value your trust in our services and are committed to ensuring that such issues do not occur in the future.

Please be assured that we have taken steps to review our processes to prevent any similar occurrences in the future. We are here to serve you and we are committed to resolving any issues promptly and efficiently.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan  
Customer Relations  
Northgate Bank

This response letter is signed by Alex Morgan, representing the Customer Relations department of Northgate Bank.

From: Alex Morgan, Customer Relations  
Sent: 25 October 2026  
To: Kerry  
Subject: Explanation and Payment Plan for Your Energy Bill

Dear Kerry,

I hope this message finds you well. I understand the concern you have expressed regarding your recent energy bill, which has risen to £412.36 for the month of October. I am writing to provide you with some clarity and to offer a solution to help manage your current situation.

Your bill has been based on an estimated meter reading, which is common practice when a new customer is first registered. Unfortunately, due to the recent change in your employment status, we have not been able to obtain an actual meter reading from you. This has resulted in an overestimation of your energy usage for the month.

We are committed to ensuring that your bill is accurate and fair. To rectify this, we kindly request that you provide us with an actual meter reading. Once we have this information, we will adjust your bill accordingly and ensure that you are charged for the correct amount of energy used.

In the meantime, we would like to offer you a payment plan to help manage your financial situation. We understand that this unexpected increase in your bill has been challenging, and we want to support you during this time. Our payment plan allows you to pay the adjusted amount over a period of 6 months, with a reduced monthly payment.

To proceed with the payment plan, please provide us with your actual meter reading as soon as possible. We will then finalize the details of the plan and send you a confirmation of your new payment schedule.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter. Your feedback is important to us, and we are here to assist you in any way we can.

Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions or need further assistance. We are here to help.

Best regards,  
Alex Morgan  
Customer Relations  
Greenfield Energy
